summary.goal: Define TypeScript types for config, outcomes, baselines, and drift alerts

acceptance_criteria.description: ForgeExecutionConfig type with model_selection, budgets, retry, parallelism, confidence, language_time_multipliers
PlannerConfig type with complexity_weights, language_complexity_multipliers, decomposition
TaskOutcome type with run_id, task_id, step_id, model_used, outcome, attempts, duration, tokens, cost, error_category?, verification?, ac_results?
VerificationResults type with: tests_passed?, tests_total?, build_passed?, type_check_passed?, lint_passed?
ErrorCategory enum: syntax_error, test_failure, type_error, build_error, lint_error, timeout, runtime_error, unknown
ACResult type with: ac_id, passed, evidence? (for automated AC verification)
RunOutcome type with aggregate metrics including verification_summary { tests_passed, tests_failed, build_passed, ac_met, ac_total }
TaskBaseline type with mean, stddev for duration/tokens, success_rate, verification_rate
ModelBaseline type with alpha, beta (Beta distribution params)
DriftAlert type with type, pattern, deviation_sigmas, severity
Zod schemas for all types with validation
